display_name: 当前三tap增强与可迁移源谱形方向的覆盖诊断
description: 复用已有L-only18折跨TX/day频谱统计；比较当前abs(a)<=.06三tap族的有界容量及只放松幅度的形状覆盖。非新训练或泛化成绩。
authorization: Active goal and source-only question frozen in e7745dbdf before target analysis. Diagnose current A_g; no new IQ/model/truth access or training, no budget extension.

code.environment: F:/App/miniconda3/python.exe; NumPy; local CPU2, no torch import

data.dataset: Existing saved L-derived contrast arrays only; no raw dataset open
data.representation: fixed rectangular/centered logPSD32 -> orthonormal DCT1to8; existing18fold predicted and observed RX contrasts

roles.U_use: IQ/RX/day/opaque UID;15domain round-robin, within-domain private permutation before reuse; no TX grouping or same-sig cross-RX pairing

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1 unchanged; U_s TX truth never visible
data.diagnostic_access: Saved source L6300 aggregate plus source-role metadata only. No new IQ, U, V, model, target or truth read.

permissions.claim_scope: Ideal magnitude-response capacity and held-out source contrast arithmetic, not finite-IQ identity or unseen-RX recognition

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Saved source-only completion and exact L physical-role metadata, no checkpoint consumed
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No model loaded; reuse unchanged source statistics originally computed without a model
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed primary rectangular/DCT1to8; no window/seed/target selection

execution.gpu_policy: No CUDA/model; two local numerical threads
execution.stop_rule: Unexpected source-role/primary/config/numerical mismatch or output collision: preserve outputs, stop, no automatic retry; no foreign process mutation

metric_names: held-out MSE after bounded and relaxed projection
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: deterministic source aggregate arithmetic; no truth/scorer process
metrics_plan.selection_rule: fine grid17radii/2048angles primary;9/1024 resolution control; difference>.01 inconclusive; direction<.5 gap,>=.8 substantial,otherwise mixed; no automatic training or chosen amplitude

rows.seed_notes: Deterministic saved-source geometry;392005 labels original physical split only. No stochastic augmentation/model/support/evaluation seed, no seed replication.
rows.scenario: source aggregate only; no satellite simulation
rows.budget_ref: 0 new model,0 epochs,0 optimizer,0 model forward; reuse6300-derived18x5x8 source arrays; fixed two grids

config.scope: Ideal power-response proxy, not finite-IQ or identity-performance evidence

notes: Existing source spectral diagnosis already found primary MSE .614141 on18folds; do not repeat raw-IQ statistics.
Old33tap PHYS/ROT training exists and is not declared a proven winner. New analysis only asks current three-tap magnitude coverage.
Dictionary is an ideal flat-within-bin/infinite-signal power proxy; does not model finite boundaries, window convolution, unknown within-bin spectrum, log-floor or phase effects.
Projection choices depend on source crossfit predictions, never held-out observed contrast. Relaxed scalar is diagnostic, not a deployed action, TX-defined session or chosen training amplitude.

Local-only arithmetic: no N607 mutation/release/transfer/GPU or model checkpoint is consumed; corresponding remote preflight/archive/real-checkpoint smoke are not applicable to this stage. Focused math/protocol negatives and one limited P0/P1 review apply.
All source-only results reported. Directional gap can motivate a separate finite-IQ/default-head experiment only; no identity gain or next training candidate is established.
